Crear metadata
```{r}
#leer el archivo Excel original
metadata <- here("data", "seq_202610", "202610_sequencing_database.xlsx")

datos <- read_excel(metadata, sheet = 3)

datos %>% 
  mutate(seq_index_name_1= paste0(Well,"_CS1" ),
         seq_index_name_2= paste0(Well,"_CS2" )) %>% 
  rename (Sample=Sample_ID,
          primerF_seq=PrimerF_seq,
          primerR_seq=PrimerR_seq,
          locus=Locus) ->datos
```


```{r}
#rellenar los nombres de los archivos FASTQ
datos$file1 <- "L2_MKDL260019001-1A_23NVTWLT4_L1_1.fq.gz"
datos$file2 <- "L2_MKDL260019001-1A_23NVTWLT4_L1_2.fq.gz"

#guardar como CSV en data/seq_202610/
output <- here("data", "seq_202610", "metadata.csv")

write_csv(
  datos,
  file = output
)

```

La pipeline da un error pq el nombre de la muestra esta repetido. Creo que es pq esta puesto el nombre de la botella de agua/filtro, y no de la replica de PCR

```{r}
  unite(Sample, rep, col="Sample", sep="_rep") -> datos

write_csv(

  file = output
)

```

```{r}
outputs <- list.dirs(target, recursive = F)
names(outputs) <- c("Dada2", "Vsearch")

outputs %>% 
  map(~list.files(path = .x, pattern="ASV_table.csv", full.names = T) %>% 
        read_csv() %>% 
        summarise(nHashes= n_distinct(Hash),
                  nr     = sum(nReads))) %>% 
  bind_rows(.id="clustering") -> noswarm

outputs %>% 
  map(~list.files(path = .x, pattern="new_ASV*", full.names = T) %>% 
        read_csv() %>% 
        summarise(nHashes= n_distinct(Hash),
                  nr     = sum(nReads))) %>% 
  bind_rows(.id="clustering") -> swarm

bind_rows(swarm %>% mutate(secondary_clustering= "swarm"),
          noswarm %>% mutate(secondary_clustering= "no swarm"))
```

After metabarcoding and blast let´s study the sequences. Open the 3 files
```{r}
here()
# Read the ASV table
asv_tableV <- read_csv(here("data/seq_202610/pipeline_output/demultiplexed_20261021_1254/new_ASV_after_swarm.csv"))

ids_tableV <- read_delim(here("data/seq_202610/pipeline_output/blast_output/ids_threshold.rCRUX.fasta.tsv"), delim = "\t"
)

metadataV <- read_csv(here("data/seq_202610/metadata.csv"))

mergedV <- left_join(asv_tableV, ids_tableV, by = c("Hash" = "qseqid"))
```

create table
```{r}
#How many ASVa were assigned a taxaid
sum(!is.na(mergedV$consensus))

mergedV %>% 
  group_by(is.na(consensus)) %>% 
  summarise(nseqs = sum(nReads),
            nHashes= n_distinct(Hash))

mergedV %>%
  filter(!is.na(consensus)) %>%
  group_by(
    Sample,
    Taxa = consensus) %>% 
  summarise(Reads = sum(nReads)
  )-> species_tableV

species_biol_tableV <- inner_join(species_tableV, metadataV)

species_tableV %>% 
  anti_join(metadataV)
```

To count how many samples each taxon appears in

```{r}
species_tableV |>
  ungroup() |>
  count(Taxa, sort = TRUE)
```
This returns one row for each unique taxon detected across all sample with >98 pdent

```{r}
mergedV |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(max_pident > 98) |>
  distinct(consensus) -> species_listV
```

Filtering species-level taxonomic assignments with >98% identity per sample
```{r}
species_table_98V <- mergedV %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(consensus),
    max_pident > 98
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !grepl("NA$", consensus)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Sample,
    Taxa = consensus
  ) %>%
  summarise(.groups = "drop")
```


Let´s see why the kanguroo is in every sample - table with Biol_sample, taxa, nreads y nreps
```{r}
species_biol_summaryV <- species_tableV %>%
  mutate(
    Biol_sample = sub("_rep[123]$", "", Sample)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Biol_sample,
    Taxa
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    nReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    nReps = n_distinct(Sample),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(Biol_sample, Taxa, nReads, nReps) %>%
  arrange(Biol_sample, desc(nReads))
```

Filtering by species
```{r}
species_biol_summaryV <- species_tableV %>%
  mutate(
    Biol_sample = sub("_rep[123]$", "", Sample)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Biol_sample, Taxa) %>%
  summarise(
    nReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    nReps = n_distinct(Sample),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  distinct(Biol_sample, Taxa, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(str_detect(Taxa, "Macropodidae")) %>% View()
```

### Illumina samples - Cabañeros and Vigo air
```{r}
here()
# Read the ASV table
asv_tableC <- read_csv(here("data/seq_202610/demultiplexed_20261021_1216_Illumina/new_ASV_after_swarm.csv"))

ids_tableC <- read_delim(here("data/seq_202610/pipeline_output/blast_output/ids_threshold_100_99_97_95_90_split_part_0000.fasta.tsv"), delim = "\t"
)

#Read and select the cabañeros metadata and change it so it matches with the sequence db
metadata <- here("data", "seq_202610", "202610_sequencing_database.xlsx")
datos <- read_excel(metadata, sheet = 2)

metadataC <- datos %>%
  mutate(Sample = str_replace(Sample, "_rep([123])$", "_R\\1"))

mergedC <- left_join(asv_tableC, ids_tableC, by = c("Hash" = "qseqid"))
```

create table
```{r}
#How many ASVa were assigned a taxaid
sum(!is.na(mergedC$consensus))

mergedC %>% 
  group_by(is.na(consensus)) %>% 
  summarise(nseqs = sum(nReads),
            nHashes= n_distinct(Hash))

mergedC %>%
  filter(!is.na(consensus)) %>%
  group_by(
    Sample,
    Taxa = consensus) %>% 
  summarise(Reads = sum(nReads)
  )-> species_tableC

species_biol_tableC <- inner_join(species_tableC, metadataC)

species_tableC %>% 
  anti_join(metadataC)
```

### Counting the occurrence of each taxon across samples

```{r}
species_tableC |>
  ungroup() |>
  count(Taxa, sort = TRUE)
```
This returns one row for each unique taxon detected across all samples.

```{r}
mergedC |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(max_pident > 98) |>
  distinct(consensus) -> species_listC

species_listC <- mergedC |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(max_pident > 98) |>
  distinct(Sample, consensus)
```

Filtering species-level taxonomic assignments with >98% identity per sample
```{r}
species_table_98C <- mergedC %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(consensus),
    max_pident > 98
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !grepl("NA$", consensus)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Sample,
    Taxa = consensus
  ) %>%
  summarise(.groups = "drop")
```
